expectations.text: Explains that B-UML names cannot contain spaces
expectations.evidence: 'All B-UML names — classes, attributes, associations, enumerations, literals — must not contain spaces.' Also notes hyphens are similarly rejected.

expectations.text: Recommends using underscores: 'first_name' instead of 'first name'
expectations.evidence: Property(name='first_name', type=StringType) shown as the correction; 'Replace the space with an underscore'

expectations.text: Explains that enumeration literals must have unique names within the same enum
expectations.evidence: 'Each EnumerationLiteral inside a single Enumeration must have a unique name. You can't have two literals both called ACTIVE in the same enum'

expectations.text: Provides corrected code for both issues
expectations.evidence: Combined corrected example shows Person class with first_name and Status enum with ACTIVE/INACTIVE
